methods.label: Compare cents with one dollar
methods.explanation:
A penny, nickel, dime, and quarter are worth \(1\), \(5\), \(10\), and \(25\) cents. Their total is
\[
1+5+10+25=41\text{ cents}.
\]
One dollar is \(100\) cents, so Walter has \(41/100=\boxed{41\%}\) of a dollar, choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
